pages.text: DORIME is a reference to the Ameno meme.$(br2)Ameno was released in 1996 by ERA, a French music project. The song is much older than the meme that eventually grew around it.

Ameno started showing up in internet culture long before 'Dorime' became a common meme. It was used in Twitch streams, videos and remixes, and by the late 2010s the word 'Dorime' had become strongly associated with the song.$(br2)The meme is usually paired with the song's dramatic music and vocals, often over pictures of the famous white-robed rat.

pages.title: DORIME
pages.text: Put the disc in a jukebox to play Ameno.$(br2)There isn't much more to it. It's here because DORIME.
